notes.title: Mini bug fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed issues related to the save system.
[*]Resolved the bug where exiting and re-entering the game during the 2nd mission caused the 1st mission to reappear.
[*]Fixed an issue where some items couldn’t be dropped using the "E" key.
[*]Key rebinding was not working properly, and this issue has been fixed.
[*]The internet speed upgrade wasn’t saving and would reset upon re-entering the game; this has been resolved.
[*]Fixed the problem of some papers disappearing.
[*]Resolved the issue where the night wouldn’t properly darken after exiting and re-entering the game.
[*]Fixed the bug where the fragile item sticker displayed as $1 on the machine instead of the intended $5.
[/list]
